claims.baseline_assumptions: Article-era software/data; full external implementation verification is a separate project.

claims.baseline_assumptions: Research questions are not established claims or automatically required new discoveries.
claims.remaining_obligation: Keep explicit source open-question inventory and needed definitions; assess any new theorem independently.

claims.title: Big/Little common-observable law
claims.source_claim: Hudson and Griffiths formulations describe equivalent recombinant ancestry while their processes and graphs differ.
claims.baseline_assumptions: Same sample/genome/rate/clock conventions; explicit irrelevant-event projection and MRCA stopping.
claims.remaining_obligation: Define both processes with matched parameters and prove equality in law of named sample ancestry/local-tree observables.
claims.audit_qualification: The statement 'No coupling or probability-law model' is too broad after the count/clock additions: a count/clock law exists, while a matched Big/Little sample-observable law remains absent.

claims.baseline_assumptions: Finding a compatible history, finding lower bounds and certifying optimum are different tasks.
claims.remaining_obligation: Recover exact decision problem, mutation assumptions, input encoding and threshold; prove polynomial reduction with yes/no equivalence.

claims.title: Coalescent, ASG and inference history
claims.source_claim: Overview distinguishes processes, graph realizations, inference approximations and ASG nonuniform tree selection.
claims.baseline_assumptions: No transfer of recombination graph proofs to mutation, selection or posterior laws.
claims.remaining_obligation: If claiming mathematical coverage of the ASG description, define random graph and tree-selection kernel. Historical mentions do not require proving every cited article.

claims.baseline_assumptions: The clock theorem assumes a>0, b>=0 and a finite initial natural count n>=1, with literal source specialization a=1, b=rho. Count one is stopped; the natural-zero totalization is almost surely avoided. Spatial claims additionally require an explicit positive genome length and coordinate regime; a discrete breakpoint sampler must not be silently substituted for a continuous uniform law.
claims.remaining_obligation: Construct the source's marked spatial event sampler: uniform selection of a lineage for recombination, a distinct unordered pair for common ancestry, and a breakpoint strictly inside the genome with the specified uniform law. Update extant lineage identities and dated event/edge records, prove valid finite graph prefixes, and prove that forgetting marks and graph data gives this timed stopped count law. A full real-time Markov-state theorem requires its own state-process construction if claimed.
claims.audit_qualification: Use actual lineage identities and distinguish discrete links from continuous breakpoints. The source's Figure A1 is explicitly discrete; Big prose does not explicitly announce a coordinate-model change. Either parameterize the breakpoint law or name the continuous interpretation.

claims.baseline_assumptions: Finite a>0 and b>=0, positive finite initial count n>=1; literal source rates use a=1 and b=rho. Assertions hold almost surely under the constructed law, not on every ambient path and not with a uniform deterministic time bound. The flat zero-padded tail after the first hit contains no further actual event.
claims.remaining_obligation: Construct and validate the marked spatial Big-ARG sampler in B04 and prove its timed count projection has the constructed joint law. Transfer the finite-prefix and finite-physical-time result to that source-faithful graph process, establishing its almost-sure absorption and absence of infinitely many actual pre-absorption events. Do not list the already-proved holding-time construction or count-history finite physical time as still open. Exact expected-event formulas and asymptotics belong to B07 and are separate from this absorption claim.
claims.audit_qualification: Finite jump index and finite physical time are already proved for the count/clock law. Only transfer to a valid marked recording process is needed for the stated source absorption claim; a full real-time Markov-state theorem is a separate stronger development.

claims.title: Little-ARG absorption
claims.source_claim: Every coordinate eventually coalesces and active lineages disappear.
claims.baseline_assumptions: Initial finite discrete genome/sample/rate; continuum extension separate.
claims.remaining_obligation: Prove nonexplosion and almost-sure retirement of all coordinates, directly or via a justified coupling.

claims.title: Big exponential event growth
claims.source_claim: The article writes O(exp(rho)) events to grand MRCA and cites Griffiths-Marjoram 1997.
claims.baseline_assumptions: Fix n>=2, random cost, absorption/integrability and rho normalization; time rescaling leaves birth/death ratio unchanged.
claims.remaining_obligation: Resolve expectation, event type, asymptotic regime and rate convention. Literal rates suggest a factor-of-two exponential mismatch; prove the correctly matched result.
claims.audit_qualification: The source gives O(exp(rho)) without a fully quantified cost variable/regime. With literal rates choose(k,2), k*rho the normalized ratio is 2*rho. No erratum or O(exp(2*rho)) theorem has been established by this audit.

claims.title: Matrix moves and along-genome SPR
claims.source_claim: Parsimony methods use sequence row/column moves or successive tree rearrangements.
claims.baseline_assumptions: Mutation model, finite matrix encoding, rooting and moves explicit; heuristics do not certify optima.
claims.remaining_obligation: Define named mutation/coalescence/recombination moves and prove compatibility of constructed ARGs; formalize event-to-SPR relation including invisible events.

claims.title: Monte Carlo, approximations and consensus
claims.source_claim: Methods average over ARGs or approximate models; consensus uses breakpoint frequency threshold k plus extra filters and local consensus trees.
claims.baseline_assumptions: A sampled cloud is not all compatible histories; graph validity does not prove sampler correctness.
claims.remaining_obligation: Obtain precise primary target/approximation and filtering/consensus rules for any claimed formal coverage; prove a clearly named property.
